*Brindle's slate pays for the Outworks too: defeat 50 lampbats, gloomeyes or ditch rats in the ruined defences under the walls. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Brindle will pay it again, any time.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 50 Outworks monsters ([Lampbat](../monsters/lampbat.md), [Gloomeye](../monsters/gloomeye.md), [Ditch Rat](../monsters/ditch_rat.md))

- 2,000 mesos
